cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Studenti získají základní znalosti o produkčních systémech aplikovaných v chovech hospodářských zvířat ve světě a v EU. Získají rovněž dovednost analyzovat a syntetizovat faktory, které ovlivňují tržní produkci těchto zvířat.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: In this course the students will learn about essential theoretical principles of production systems used in the field of livestock breeding in the world and EU. These principles can be thereafter applied when solving practical problems occurring in their trade production.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction into the theory of production systems used for individual species of farm animals in the world and EU (allowance 4/4) a.Theory of production systemsb.Historical development of production systemsc.Mutual links among individual components of production systems2.Production systems used in cattle breeding in the world and EU (allowance 10/10) a.Production system of combined performance of cattle (milk and slaughter animals)b.Production system of milk production and supplementary production of slaughter animalsc.Production system oriented to production of breeding and slaughter animals3.Production systems used in pig breeding in the world and EU (allowance 4/4) a.Production system oriented to production of slaughter animalsb.Production system oriented to production of reared animals4.Production systems used in poultry (domestic fowl) breeding in the world and EU (allowance 4/4) a.Production system oriented to production of eggsb.Production system oriented to production of broilers5.Production system used in sheep breeding in the world and EU (allowance 4/4) a.Production system oriented to production of slaughter lambsb.Production system oriented above all to production of milk and supplementary production of wool and slaughter animals6.Production system used in goat breeding in the world and EU (allowance 2/2) a.Production system oriented above all to production of milk and supplementary production of slaughter animals

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Participation at seminars at least 80%. Participation at field exercises at least 100%. The course is finished by written and oral exam. The written exam takes 60 minutes and contributes to the overall result of 50%. The oral exam takes 30 minutes and contributes to the overall results also 50%. In both parts is required at least 60% success rate.
